title: fix(console): settings pages re-read their namespace after a save or action (objectui#13382)
body:
Closes #13382
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`SettingsView` (`apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsView.tsx`) now reads its namespace again after a successful save or action, through the same `getSettingsNamespace` the load effect uses, and takes the whole payload, manifest included. After objectstack#25448 the server puts a live-status `info_banner` (id `live_status`) first in `manifest.specifiers` on every read, so Setup → Email's banner now follows a save without a reload.

- **Save:** the PUT's values are still merged and the draft, field-error and crypto-refusal resets are unchanged. The success toast fires, then the re-read runs.
- **Action:** the re-read runs only when the action answers `ok`. The draft is left as it is.
- **Re-read fails:** it is caught and ignored, so the merged values and the success toast stay and the page does not turn into an error.
- **No placeholder flash:** `loading` is not flipped.
- **Stale guard:** the load effect has no cancellation of its own, so a read counter (`readSeqRef`) is added. The load effect bumps it, and each re-read applies only while it is still the latest. A re-read that lands after a namespace change, or after a newer re-read, is dropped.

## Tests

- New `SettingsView.rereadAfterSave-13382.test.tsx`: a fake `fetch` whose first GET answers "No mail leaves this machine" and every later GET answers "Mail is delivered through SMTP (…)". Six cases:
  - control: the first load is unchanged and sends one GET;
  - after a save the new banner shows, with no remount (the same field-list node) and the saved value and toast present;
  - after a successful action the new banner shows;
  - an unsaved draft survives an action and its re-read;
  - a save whose re-read rejects still shows the saved value and the success toast, with no error toast and no load-failure card;
  - a re-read held in flight and released after a move to another namespace is dropped.
- **Ablation:** with the `SettingsView.tsx` change reverted, 4 of the 6 cases fail and the control passes. The namespace-change case passes there because nothing re-reads. With only the load effect's counter bump removed, that case fails and the other 5 pass.
- **Sibling fakes:** two existing fakes answered every GET with a fixed fixture while their PUT answered other values, a server that contradicts itself. The re-read exposed that.
  - `SettingsView.unsetAndReset-13145` and `SettingsView.languageKeepsDraft-13254`: each fake now stores what its PUT wrote, and later GETs return it.
  - The 13254 case "after a language change, Save sends the kept edit and the bar goes" still asserts that the language change sent no GET. After the save it now expects the one re-read, so it is a second pin for this fix: it fails with the fix reverted.
- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/ --maxWorkers=2`: 29 files and 239 tests passed, at `5ee1459d6d`.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/console...`: 71/71 successful. The console's `tsconfig.json` includes `src`, so the tests are type-checked too.
- `eslint` on the four touched files: 0 errors and 3 `no-explicit-any` warnings, all on existing `catch (err: any)` lines. With `--no-inline-config` there is 1 error, `react-hooks/static-components` on the existing `getLazyIcon` line, whose inline disable that flag ignores. `origin/main`'s copy of the file gives the same error, so it is not new here.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` ✅, `check-changeset-no-major` ✅, `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.

## Changeset

`.changeset/13382-settings-reread-after-save.md`, a `@object-ui/console` patch.

## Acceptance notes

- The load effect itself still has no stale guard: if namespace A's first GET resolves after a move to B, it could still land. This PR does not change that path (the card's control is "first load unchanged"), and it was not reproduced here.
- I have not checked this in a running console against objectstack#25448. The pins drive the page over a stubbed `fetch`.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
